name: Project SAGE
source:
The story is about an independent young girl who decides to move to another country to start a new life after losing her family. Slowly, she discovers herself, her heritage and her destiny. 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/paperwork]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了一个独立的年轻女孩在失去家人后决定移居另一个国家开始新生活的故事。慢慢地，她发现了自己、她的遗产和她的命运。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/paperwork]Patreon[/url]]
